title: Lunar Prospector Alpha Particle Spectrometer Data
description: Relative count rate maps for Radon-222 and Polonium-210 derived from the Lunar Prospector Alpha Particle Spectrometer (January 1998 – July 1999). Data acquired during high- and low-altitude mission phases. Mapped onto 336 equal-area pixels (~300 km × 450 km at equator). Source: PDS Geosciences Node, January 2002.
